name: create_thread
description: Create a chat thread for MCP plans/uploads/sparks. Returns threadId.

name: list_threads
description: List recent chat threads for this user.

name: set_active_thread
description: Set the active threadId for subsequent tools in this MCP session.

name: confirm_tool
description: Execute a previously gated confirm tool by confirmId.

name: get_spark_job
description: Poll a spark job by id (from fetch_spark).

name: list_sources
description: List video sources in the user's library (chat does not auto-add them to Create). Use these sourceIds in set_render_plan / preview_plan.

name: list_images
description: List still images in the library plus recent chat attachments. images[] is library insertion order. attachedInOrder is this turn's chat images. When the user said 'in order' / 'images added', chunk attachedInOrder (else images[]) sequentially into carousels.

name: get_workspace
description: Get captions, style, and batch options for the current plan. In chat this returns the thread plan (source=thread); outside chat it returns Create workspace.json (source=create). Does not return named Create plans from GET /api/plans — use list_plans for chat thread plans across chats.

name: set_captions
description: Replace this chat’s caption list (one hook per line). Use ONLY for matrix mode where every caption applies to every video. For N captions per video (or uneven mixes), use set_render_plan instead. Does not change Create until the user presses Send to Create on Plan. Every line must be fully readable on a phone and clear of TikTok UI.

captions.description: Full captions text, one per line

name: add_captions
description: Append hooks to the flat workspace caption list. Prefer set_render_plan when captions belong to specific videos.

captions.description: Hooks to append, one string per caption

name: set_render_plan
description: REQUIRED when writing captions for specific videos. Submit the full plan as structured JSON: each video’s sourceId plus its caption list. Saves the active render plan (shared across chats; same data /preview shows). Set newPlan true to add another plan instead of replacing the current one (e.g. a second batch of captions on the same videos). Do NOT paste caption lists as markdown in chat — call this tool instead. Call list_sources first to get sourceIds. Call list_plans first when the user wants captions that are not the same as an existing plan. When captions come from ask_models or /multiple, pass captionDetails [{text, model, origin: '/multiple'}] (and origin '/multiple' on the plan) so the Plan spreadsheet shows which model wrote each row.

videos.description: One entry per source video with its captions

captions.description: Hooks for this video only, in order. For mixed-model plans you may instead pass objects like {text, model, origin} in this array — the server accepts both shapes.

origin.description: How captions were produced, e.g. chat, /all, /multiple, or pinterest

model.description: Default model label when captions do not set their own model

captionDetails.description: Optional per-caption tags matched by text. Use after ask_models / /multiple so Plan shows which model wrote each hook: [{text, model, origin}].

newPlan.description: If true, create a new plan and leave existing plans untouched. Use when the user asks for another plan, another 40 captions, a second batch, etc.

title.description: Optional label for this plan, e.g. 'Night-out hooks v2'

showUi.description: If true, open the plan spreadsheet. Leave false when continuing to start_render / upload.

name: set_carousel_plan
description: REQUIRED for native TikTok photo carousels. Build N carousels of 1–5 stills each with one TikTok description caption per carousel. When the user says images 'in order', chunk ordered image ids sequentially (e.g. 20 images → 10 two-slide carousels). Pass carousels[] with slides + caption, OR count + slideCount + imageIds + captions. Do not call start_render for carousels — use start_carousel_upload then fetch_spark.

slides.description: 1–5 image library ids in slide order

imageIds.description: Ordered image ids to chunk when using count/slideCount

count.description: How many carousels to build from imageIds in order

captions.description: One caption per carousel, same order as groups

name: list_plans
description: List chat thread plans across all chats (title, counts, captions). Not the same as GET /api/plans (Create/workspace named plans). Call this before writing a new plan so captions are not duplicates.

name: ask_models
description: Run the same prompt on several chat models in parallel (text only, no tools). Use when the user wants multiple models to brainstorm captions, Pinterest search angles, or hooks. Then merge the best lines into set_render_plan with per-caption {text, model} and origin '/multiple'. For Pinterest discovery: ask_models for short search topics / angles, then YOU call search_pinterest + pinterest_set (do not run Pinterest tools from each model). Render and upload use start_render / start_tiktok_upload on the merged plan (jobs may queue if others are already running).

models.description: Model ids from the catalog, e.g. claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5.4, grok-4.6, gemini-3.6-flash. Same provider allowed.

prompt.description: Prompt each selected model should answer

purpose.description: Optional hint: captions | pinterest | hooks | general

name: list_offers
description: List affiliate offers (hook generator).

name: get_offer
description: Get one offer including winners, likes, and pastCaptions (every hook already made for this offer). Pin it as the active offer so later plan captions go into that bank.

name: list_offer_captions
description: List past on-screen captions for an offer (winners, likes, and generation/plan history). Pass this bank to Opus before writing new Reco / offer hooks.

name: set_active_offer
description: Pin the offer new chat/plan captions belong to (Reco, Freecash, …).

name: create_offer
description: Create an affiliate offer.

name: add_winner
description: Save a winning hook on an offer.

name: add_like
description: Like a generated hook for an offer.

name: generate_hooks
description: Generate affiliate hooks with Claude Opus. Reads the offer's past caption bank first. Default mode new_angles. variations/mix also ok.

randomWords.description: Default false. Leave off unless asked. Reco lines say the money, tag income with [[uncompliant:income]], and match the clip.

name: set_style
description: Update caption look style settings in the workspace.

name: set_end_caption
description: Set end-of-video caption on a source (or apply template to all).

name: set_batch_options
description: Set matrix/pair/custom mode, name template, skip/dedupe.

name: list_outputs
description: List rendered output videos in the library.

name: list_tiktok_accounts
description: List TikTok accounts (no cookie secrets).

name: get_batch_status
description: Poll a render batch by id.

name: get_upload_status
description: Poll a TikTok upload job by id.

name: preview_plan
description: Build and save the active render plan (source×caption pairs; shared across chats). Pass pairs for a custom mix. Set newPlan true to add another plan instead of replacing the active one. Does not encode. By default does NOT open UI (use this when automating into start_render). Set showUi true only when the user asked to review the spreadsheet now.

newPlan.description: If true, save as a new plan instead of replacing the active plan.

title.description: Optional label for a new or updated plan

showUi.description: If true, open the plan spreadsheet for the user to review. Leave false when continuing to start_render / upload.

name: search_pinterest
description: Search Pinterest for pins matching a keyword. Use mediaType=image for stills (carousels) and mediaType=video for clips. Discovers pins for the model only — does NOT show the chat grid and does NOT download. After searching, you MUST call pinterest_set with action=show and the best pins (or all if few) so the user sees a selectable grid. Pass excludeUrls to skip denied or already-shown pins.

mediaType.description: video (default), image for carousel stills, or any

name: pinterest_set
description:
Canonical Pinterest pin-set for chat. THIS is how pins appear in the grid or get downloaded — never invent pin lists in prose.
action=show: put pins in the selectable chat grid (user can click to attach without downloading). mode=replace (default) replaces the shown set; mode=merge adds to it.
action=download: download pins into the library. If pins is empty, uses attached pins, then the last shown set, then the thread bank.
Each pin needs pinUrl; copy thumbnail/title/previewUrl from search_pinterest when available.

name: inspect_sources
description: Extract 1–2 still frames from downloaded source videos so you can see what is on screen. Use after videos are in the library.

name: find_carousel_formats
description: Find more photo-carousel formats like a reaction creator (screen-record of TikTok Photo posts, then talking head). Pass a public Instagram/TikTok profile URL, or specific post urls[]. Downloads each video, pulls early frames, and returns them so you can read the on-screen slide text. Then remake those formats with set_carousel_plan — do not clone the original photos. Limit 1–16 (default 8).

urls.description: Specific reel/post URLs when the profile playlist is blocked

name: analyze_example_ad
description: Analyze a public TikTok post/ad URL as a creative example: description, hashtags, cover stills (vision), optional transcript, and suggested Pinterest search seeds. Use when the user pastes a TikTok link as a reference and wants similar Pinterest images + caption variations. Does not download the video into the library (use add_source_url for that).

url.description: Public TikTok video / ad share URL

getTranscript.description: If true, also fetch spoken transcript (extra credits)

name: propose_ideas
description: Show video×caption ideas in Chat for the user to watch, approve, or deny. Use ONLY when the user wants captioned approve/deny cards (e.g. make 10 captioned ideas). For picking/showing/downloading clips alone, use pinterest_set instead. Ideas start approved; the user only has to deny pins they do not want. Does not download or render. Call AFTER search_pinterest / pinterest_set, BEFORE add_source_urls / start_render. targetCount is how many ideas the user asked for. On refill, only send the remaining slots — already-approved ideas are kept by the UI. Never ask which pins in text.

name: add_source_url
description: Download a TikTok/YouTube/Pinterest URL into the video library and current job. Requires user confirm.

name: add_source_urls
description: Download several TikTok/YouTube/Pinterest URLs into the library. Requires user confirm.

name: start_render
description: Start burning captions onto videos. Requires user confirm. Optionally pass pairs [{sourceId, caption}] for checked Preview tiles only. May return status queued if other renders are already running (up to 2 concurrent); keep using the returned batchId.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry-safe key; reuse on client retries

name: start_tiktok_upload
description: Upload rendered videos from a finished batch to TikTok. Requires user confirm. Pass batchId from start_render. Optional accountId forces that TikTok account for every video (ignores Settings round-robin). May return status queued.

accountId.description: Force this TikTok account id for the whole upload (from the plan picker). Overrides Settings selection.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry-safe key; reuse on client retries

name: start_carousel_upload
description: Publish native TikTok photo carousels from the active carousel plan (Studio, 1–5 images per post). Requires user confirm. Do not use start_render. Always returns a jobId immediately — poll upload status; `wait` is ignored. Pass soundQuery (TikTok sound search, e.g. 'if i can breathe i can think') and/or soundPath (local audio) so the carousel is not silent.

soundQuery.description: Studio sound search, e.g. if i can breathe i can think

soundPath.description: Local audio file to attach if search cannot pick the sound

useOriginalSound.description: After get_custom_sound ready=true, attach this account's Recent original sound.

wait.description: Ignored — always returns jobId immediately; poll status tools instead.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry-safe key; reuse on client retries

name: create_custom_sound
description: Seed a TikTok original sound by posting a Studio video whose audio is the custom track (audioPath, videoPath, or sourceId). Returns uploadId immediately. Poll get_custom_sound until review is approved before start_carousel_upload / start_tiktok_upload with useOriginalSound. Requires user confirm.

audioPath.description: Local audio file (mp3/m4a). Muxed onto a still if no videoPath.

videoPath.description: Local video that already contains the custom audio.

sourceId.description: Library source whose file already has the custom audio.

imagePath.description: Optional still used when muxing audioPath into a seed video.

caption.description: Seed video description (used later to find the Studio row).

name: get_custom_sound
description: Poll a custom original-sound seed. Pass jobId from create_custom_sound (or accountId + query). review is uploading|pending|approved|private|rejected. Approved (ready=true) means the Studio Content row is Everyone with no 'Content under review' badge — that is the green light to start_carousel_upload / start_tiktok_upload with useOriginalSound. Only me or a review badge is not approved.

query.description: Seed caption to find in Studio Content if jobId is omitted.

name: fetch_spark
description: Start a DuoPlus Spark (ad authorization) job for posted plan rows. Always returns a jobId immediately — `wait` is ignored. Poll get_spark_job until codes are ready. Rows without a post URL are skipped.

wait.description: Ignored — always returns jobId immediately; poll status tools instead.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry-safe key; reuse on client retries

name: list_facebook_accounts
description: List connected Facebook ad accounts, Pages, and connection status.

name: list_facebook_campaigns
description: List Facebook ad campaigns on the selected ad account.

name: list_facebook_adsets
description: List Facebook ad sets, optionally filtered by campaignId.

name: list_facebook_pixels
description: List Facebook pixels on the selected ad account.

name: start_facebook_ads
description: Upload rendered videos to Facebook Ads as paused ads. Requires user confirm. mode: new_campaign, new_adset (needs campaignId), or existing_adset (needs adsetId). landingUrl is required. Uses Settings defaults for page, pixel, budget, and bid unless overridden.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry-safe key; reuse on client retries

name: delete_sources
description: Delete source videos by id. Requires user confirm.

name: delete_outputs
description: Delete rendered output files. Requires user confirm.

name: get_bc_settings
description: Read Business Center options: day-one one-time ad-account budget (default $5), Sales Instant Page bid/budget/URL/CTAs, white-hat Spark code, extra ad accounts, add-balance amount, Mercury cap, VAT, and the last budget run (including errors).

name: set_bc_settings
description: Update Business Center options. Use adAccountBudgetUsd (or amountUsd) to change the default day-one one-time budget applied to every Ads Manager account right after adding balance. Pass sparkCode for the white-hat Reach campaign Spark paste. Pass salesConversionBidUsd, salesDailyBudgetUsd, salesLandingUrl, salesInstantPageCta, salesCreativeCta, salesDisplayCard, salesAdNameTemplate, or salesCreativeText for post-white-hat Sales Instant Page ads. salesDisplayCard attaches the TAP HERE Display Card when true. Pass accountName to override budget only for that ad account. Pass cardId / activeHostId to match Settings pickers (host change restarts the embedded worker). Does not apply budgets in TikTok immediately — it changes what the next budget-manager run will set.

adAccountBudgetUsd.description: Default one-time budget in USD for every Ads Manager account on day one (e.g. 5, 10, 25).

accountName.description: If set, store this amount only for that Ads Manager name (e.g. 'shop 2'). Omit to change the default.

sparkCode.description: White-hat Spark code pasted into Ads Manager (e.g. #0QeVFz…). Alias: sparkCodeDefault.

extraAdAccounts.description: Settings default extras beyond the seed account (0–20). For a launch-specific override, pass accountsPerBc on start_spark_bc_launch or start_bc_warmup instead.

mercuryDailyLimit.description: Mercury daily spend cap in USD.

cardId.description: Saved billing card id from Settings → Business Center.

activeHostId.description: AdsPower host id to make active. Restarts the embedded provision worker so the new URL/key take effect.

salesConversionBidUsd.description: Sales Instant Page conversion (CPA) bid in USD.

salesDailyBudgetUsd.description: Sales ad-group daily budget in USD.

salesLandingUrl.description: Landing URL override (blank uses the offer URL).

salesDisplayCard.description: Attach the TAP HERE Display Card to Sales ads. True by default; false launches without a card.

salesCreativeText.description: Optional ad text on each Sales creative.

name: list_bcs
description: List Business Center inventory profiles with status, white-hat / ads-ready flags, payment-required, suspension, health, notes, and ad-account summaries. Optional view filter: warming_up, ads_ready, white_hat_pending, payment_required, disapproved, suspended, failed, needs_manual_login.

query.description: Search email, BC name, notes, account id.

name: get_bc
description: Get one BC profile with ad accounts, white-hat details, spark pack for intended offers, notes, health, and events.

name: preview_spark_bc_launch
description: Preview how many Business Centers / AdsPower profiles a Spark pack needs (10 sparks per ad account). Pass sparkCodes and/or intendedOfferIds plus optional accountsPerBc / bcCount. Returns capacity math, exclusive slices, and Mercury spend preview. Does not start a job.

accountsPerBc.description: Ad accounts per BC (default 1). 2 fits 20 sparks in one profile.

extraAdAccounts.description: Alias for accountsPerBc-1 (extras beyond the seed).

bcCount.description: Override BC count (must be ≥ ceil(sparks / capacity)).

name: start_bc_warmup
description: Warm up exactly bcCount Business Centers (default 1). A retry while that warmup is still running returns the same job and does not create another BC. Each BC gets a profile, billing, and every ad account from Settings (seed plus extraAdAccounts), then white hat on each account. Does not auto-launch Sales. Requires confirm.

bcCount.description: Number of Business Centers / AdsPower profiles (default 1).

intendedOfferIds.description: Offer ids to label these BCs (optional).

accountsPerBc.description: Ad accounts inside each BC. Omit this and extraAdAccounts to use Settings.

extraAdAccounts.description: Extras beyond the seed for this job. Omit to use Settings.

name: start_spark_bc_launch
description: Launch BCs sized from Spark count (10 per ad account) and assign exclusive Spark packs so Sales Instant Page ads run automatically after white-hat Scheduled. 20 sparks + 1 account → 2 BCs / 2 profiles; 20 sparks + 2 accounts → 1 BC. Requires confirm. Worker must be online.

bcCount.description: Override (must be ≥ minimum from capacity math).

name: get_bc_job
description: Poll a provision / BC warm-up job by id.

name: cancel_bc_job
description: Stop a running or queued BC warm-up job in place so it can be Continued from the BC table. Does not tear down the profile/proxy/Hoot. Requires confirm.

name: mark_bc_suspended
description: Manually mark a BC profile or ad account as suspended. reasonCode: policy | payment | identity | unknown. Requires confirm. Do NOT use for Business Center disapproval / failed review — use mark_bc_disapproved instead.

name: mark_bc_disapproved
description: Mark a BC profile as disapproved (failed review) — distinct from suspended. Burns the assigned proxy (unusable) and bans the Hoot account for the refund workflow. Requires confirm.

processRefund.description: Default true: mark proxy unusable + Hoot banned.

name: mark_white_hat_approved
description: Manually mark an ad account white-hat as Scheduled/approved (when verified in Ads Manager but watcher missed it). Requires confirm.

name: continue_bc
description: Resume an existing Business Center from its current incomplete step (same as the BCs Continue button). Does not create a new profile, proxy, or Hoot account. Requires confirm. Worker must be online.

name: mark_bc_payment
description: Mark payment as already added on a Business Center (same as BCs → Mark payment added). Skips the card charge. amountUsd defaults to 10. Requires confirm.

name: list_sparks
description: List loaded TikTok posts and their spend across campaigns and ad accounts.

name: get_tiktok_connection
description: Marketing API connection status for a BC profile. Never returns the token.

name: sync_tiktok_insights
description: Sync TikTok spend, impressions, and cost per conversion for connected advertisers.

name: list_topups
description: List ad-account top-up tasks.

name: update_campaign_bid
description: Change the bid on a campaign's ad group. Requires confirm.

name: update_campaign_budget
description: Change the daily budget on a campaign's ad group. Requires confirm.

name: set_campaign_status
description: Pause or enable a campaign. Requires confirm.

name: approve_topup
description: Approve a manual top-up so the PC worker can charge the card. Requires confirm.

name: start_sales_campaign
description: Launch one Sales or Lead campaign on an ad account through the Marketing API. Same as BCs → Load sparks. White-hat posted is enough; do not wait for Scheduled and do not require Spark codes. Pass profileId, optional account (1-based slot, name, or advertiser id), conversionBidUsd, dailyBudgetUsd, objective (sales or lead), landingUrl, and offerIds. sparkCodes only when the user pasted them. Set autoPick=true to choose the first available account. Requires confirm. Worker must be online. Campaign and ads are published active.

profileId.description: BC profile id. Optional when autoPick is true.

sparkCodes.description: Optional Spark codes; otherwise the assigned pack.

landingUrl.description: Instant Page website URL (else offer URL / Settings).

offerIds.description: Offer ids to attach; updates profile intendedOfferIds.

account.description: Ad account: 1-based slot, account name, or TikTok advertiser id. Default 1 (seed).

force.description: Re-enqueue even if Sales already draft/done.

autoPick.description: Pick the first available ads-ready ad account when profileId is omitted or empty.

bidScope.description: website-ios = Website destination, conversion bid, dummy Pixel, iOS only. Instant Page is CONVERT BUTTON.

itemIds.description: TikTok post item ids to load as ads.

postUrl.description: TikTok photo or video URL to load as the ad.

name: ensure_dummy_pixel
description: Reuse a Pixel already on the Business Center, or create website-dummy, and link it to the ad account. This is only so a Sales ad can use a website link. It does not create an Instant Page.

account.description: Ad account: 1-based slot, account name, or TikTok advertiser id. Default 1.

advertiserId.description: TikTok advertiser id. Overrides account when set.

name: set_bc_notes
description: Set free-text notes on a BC profile (e.g. use for DE Freecash).

name: open_bc_ads_manager
description: Enqueue opening Ads Manager for an ad account on the provision worker machine. Requires confirm. Worker must be online.
